(b) Quantitative analysis of SA-β-Gal-positive cells in fresh frozen liver tissue sections (n = 6 per group). (c) Representative immunofluorescence images of γ-H2AX staining (red) with DAPI staining (blue); scale bar: 100 μm (n = 6 per group).
